text:
support-alex: FYI — AcmeCorp just escalated. They found a potential CVE in our keystore client that requires rotating KEKs. They want ETA for rotation in Private deployments (HSM). Error they see: `decrypt failed: mac mismatch` on 2026-03-17 09:12 UTC. Details below.

jordan-sec: @support-alex thanks — can you paste the exact error payload + customer org id? :eyes: 

support-alex: Org: acme-inc-prod. Error log:
```
2026-03-17T09:12:34Z ERROR keystore.Reencrypt failed id=... decrypt err="mac mismatch" key_id="kek-01"
```
They say they rotated their local KEK yesterday, then calls started failing for old snapshots. They want us to rotate on our side and confirm audit logs and retention policy for the snapshot keys. Customer is on Private (on-prem) v2.1.3 with HSM firmware 4.2.

sam-oncall: @jordan-sec @kyle-infra I'm oncall, starting triage. Can you confirm whether we have a hot-rotate path for KEKs for Private clusters? If not, what's the fallback? :hammer_and_wrench: 

kyle-infra: We do have a rolling rewrap workflow but it requires customer to provide an authorized rotation request or have admin-agent running. For on-prem, we can send a signed rotation package. Workload: ~120 nodes, ~2TB snapshots. Estimate 3-6 hours with offline rewrap.

jordan-sec: Is this CVE related to the keystore client parsing bug CVE-2026-XXXX? If so, we need patch timeline and customer-facing mitigation. @pm-elaine heads up.

pm-elaine: Noted. We need commitment window ASAP. Legal & compliance want confirmation that audit logs show no exfil. @leah-legal can you chime?

leah-legal: Will review. Ask customer for exact snapshot IDs so we can check access logs and whether any external decrypt calls were made. Also need to confirm retention policy timelines.

support-alex: Asked customer for snapshot IDs. They sent one: `snap-2026-0316-7a9f`. Also they requested whether rotation would break in-flight requests.

kyle-infra: Rotation is safe but in-flight cached KV tokens could cause transient 5xx until re-cache. Recommend brief maintenance window. We'll prepare a fallback: re-encrypt with previous KEK and keep dual-key acceptance for 24h.

sam-oncall: Can infra push a mitigation package and a patch backport for v2.1.x? We need a CVE patch PR and a release candidate. Timeline aim: patch in 24h, customer rotation in 48h. Anyone object?

jordan-sec: I'll draft advisory language. Also enable audit-export for this org to S3 bucket for deeper forensics. @infra please capture HSM logs (PKCS#11) for the timeframe.

kyle-infra: On it. I'll gather HSM PKCS#11 logs and key-wrap events. Will include commands used: 
```
hsm-cli list-wrap-events --since 2026-03-16T00:00Z --org acme-inc-prod
```

dev-deploy-bot: Deploy queued: keystore-fix-CVE-2026-XXXX -> staging

sam-oncall: Great. Summarize next steps for customer and internal owners.

support-alex: Summary:
- Requested snapshot IDs (received `snap-2026-0316-7a9f`)
- Infra to collect HSM logs and prepare dual-key fallback (owner: kyle-infra)
- Security to draft advisory + coordinate CVE PR (owner: jordan-sec)
- Eng to backport patch & produce RC (owner: eng-release)
- Legal/compliance to review audit logs (owner: leah-legal)
- Oncall to plan maintenance window and customer ETA (owner: sam-oncall)

pm-elaine: I'll inform customer: propose maintenance window tomorrow 02:00-06:00 UTC, pending patch verification. Please update if timelines change. :white_check_mark:

support-alex: Customer accepted tentative window, asked for rollback plan and cost impact. They also asked if our audit logs retain keystore key IDs for 90 days.

leah-legal: Our audit log retention is 180 days for Private by default; we can export longer if needed. Confirmed no external access noted so far (preliminary).

jordan-sec: Marking thread critical. Will update when advisory text ready.

sam-oncall: I'll kick off the RCA doc and link here: <https://internal.redwood/incident/1818004321>

kyle-infra: Collected logs, attaching minimal excerpt:
```
2026-03-16T23:59:12Z EVENT wrap key_id=kek-01 action=unwrap src=snapshot id=snap-2026-0316-7a9f
2026-03-17T09:12:34Z ERROR decrypt mac mismatch key_id=kek-01 request_id=abc123
```

support-alex: Customer confirmed they will pause writes during rotation. I'll coordinate the window.

jordan-sec: Advisory draft ready, posting for review: "CVE-2026-XXXX — Keystore client parsing issue; mitigation: rotate KEKs and apply patch."

sam-oncall: Ack. Any blockers to meet 24h patch goal?

eng-release: We have a PR in progress, needs +1 from infra for HSM test harness; timeline 18h to RC.

pm-elaine: Thanks all. Keep channel updated. :pray:

support-alex: Closing notes: will follow up after rotation. Thanks team. :rocket:
